purpose: Verse 4D batch (Logos root) → numeric lens output + evidence_refs + narrative_snippet_guarded; no regime/KOSPI in same runner per Logos First.

payload_fields_v0_2.evidence_refs: Array of { verse_id, quote_hash, hash_tagged_snippet } per batch row that contributed pipeline1_simple_4d; verse_id/text from batch keys (verse_id, verse_text, …).
payload_fields_v0_2.narrative_snippet_guarded: Whitespace-joined hash_tagged_snippet lines only; clipped; no LLM prose.
payload_fields_v0_2.snippet_guard_policy: Human-readable rule string; downstream must not replace with free-form summaries.
payload_fields_v0_2.quote_hash: sha256:<hex> over UTF-8 verse_text when present; null when no text.
